raw.product_description: Envelop is an AI operating partner that takes domain experts — consultants, recruiters, ex-executives, niche operators — from business idea to honest verdict to personalized game plan to first revenue, in weeks not months. The core product is a simplified Gantt-style workspace showing the entrepreneur one path and one Next Best Action (NBA) at all times. AI agents handle ~90% of execution tasks. The funnel is: free assessment → $49 report unlock (10% convert) → $149–$449/month subscription (10% convert) → $12 extra actions (~6/subscriber/month).

unit_economics.price_tiers: Starter $149/month (25%), Launch $249/month (60%), Momentum $449/month (15%). Free assessment, $49 report unlock, $12 extra actions.

raw.thesis: Envelop addresses an unmet need for domain experts with viable business ideas who struggle with execution. The venture offers an AI-powered operating partner that guides users from idea validation to first revenue within weeks, significantly de-risking and accelerating the early stages of business development. The core innovation lies in its ability to combine honest AI assessment, personalized action plans, and agent-driven task execution in a single, streamlined platform. This approach aims to bridge the gap between generic AI advice and expensive, slow human consultants, providing a practical, affordable, and rapid path to market for niche operators. The target user is a domain expert with a concrete business idea who lacks the conviction, clear starting point, or a customized plan. This venture is positioned as a complement to traditional consulting and generic AI tools, enhancing efficiency where those solutions fall short. The founder's ambition is to build a growth-oriented startup, evident from the projected profits and the commitment to rapidly scale operations. The venture is currently at the MVP stage with a platform built, deployed, and early adopters being onboarded. It has already evolved past the initial idea phase and is demonstrating early traction with active users. Envelop is replacing the need for multiple disparate tools and services (AI, consultants) by offering a single, integrated solution that focuses on actionable steps and execution for domain experts ready to launch a business.
raw.evidence_of_stage: Platform built and deployed. Five ventures being onboarded (FreakingGenius, Inu, plus three more). Operating Partner chat live on direct Anthropic API. Assessment pipeline running end-to-end. Viral share mechanic designed but not yet validated. No paid subscribers yet.
